Ok, thanks for the clarification. It works great I have it  mining in
Harlos Pool along with my other miners. I'm just a little disappointed that
something was broken on the unit.😔

Hi Bill,

Glad to hear it's up and hashing on Harlo Pool, and I'm sorry the stand came to you with those clips broken. Even though they're only wire guides and don't affect how the unit runs, you shouldn't have opened a new miner and found a broken part.

So that it isn't just an apology, I've made you a code for your next order: ····, $25 off, it's yours alone and works on orders over $100.

If anything about the P2 ever looks off, write back here and I'll pick it up. You're also very welcome in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD and plenty of other Harlo Pool miners hang out.

Best,
Sarah
